# IT Asset Tool

> > Comprehensive free and enterprise software for network inventory, hardware monitoring, and software asset management with agentless Active Directory integration.

IT Asset Tool provides organizations with a complete solution for discovering and managing IT assets across Windows networks. The platform combines software and hardware inventory capabilities with powerful reporting and SAM compliance tracking, available in both free and enterprise editions.

## Key Topics

- Software Asset Management (SAM)
- Network Inventory
- Hardware Inventory
- Software Inventory
- Active Directory Integration
- Agentless Monitoring
- Windows Domain
- SQL Server
- SQLite Database
- License Compliance
- Asset Management
- Network Monitoring
- SNMP
- Syslog
- IT Asset Tool Enterprise

## Core Features

- [Free Inventory Software](https://www.it-asset-tool.com/features/what-is-iat): IT Asset Tool free software for network inventory, monitoring and asset management
- [Software Inventory](https://www.it-asset-tool.com/features/software-inventory): Software inventory collection and analysis with SAM compliance tracking
- [Hardware Inventory](https://www.it-asset-tool.com/features/hardware-inventory): Hardware inventory monitoring for processor, RAM and disk state tracking
- [Report Analysis](https://www.it-asset-tool.com/features/report-analysis): Powerful query engine for network asset reporting and analysis
- [Easy to Integrate](https://www.it-asset-tool.com/features/easy-to-integrate): Agentless integration with Active Directory and Windows Domain networks
